nfl-engine-capture.definition:
[Unit]
Description=Check NFL T80/T75 windows every 15 seconds

[Timer]
OnBootSec=30s
OnUnitActiveSec=15s
AccuracySec=1s
Unit=nfl-engine-capture.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

nfl-engine-daily.definition:
[Unit]
Description=NFL daily job, retaining hourly public-final refresh cadence

[Timer]
OnCalendar=hourly
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=30s
Unit=nfl-engine-daily.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

nfl-learning.definition:
[Unit]
Description=Refit Tuesdays at 06:00 Pacific, with DST
[Timer]
OnCalendar=Tue *-*-* 06:00:00 America/Los_Angeles
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=1s
Unit=nfl-learning.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

nfl-cutoff-state.definition:
[Unit]
Description=NFL Fri/Mon/Tue 06 Pacific shadow state and bounded catchup
[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon,Tue,Fri *-*-* 06:00:00 America/Los_Angeles
OnBootSec=30s
OnUnitActiveSec=60s
AccuracySec=1s
Persistent=true
Unit=nfl-cutoff-state.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

nfl-engine-watchdog.definition:
[Unit]
Description=Check NFL worker and outside observer every minute

[Timer]
OnBootSec=30s
OnUnitActiveSec=60s
AccuracySec=1s
Unit=nfl-engine-watchdog.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
